description: The U.S. Energy Information Administration publishes country-level international energy statistics. The EIA API route read on 2026-09-26 describes the International data set as country-level production, consumption, imports and exports by energy source, including petroleum, natural gas, electricity and renewables, with monthly, quarterly and annual frequencies, facets for product, activity, country or region, region type, data flag and unit, and a period from January 1949 to June 2026; the interactive product is the international data browser. Coverage is all countries and regions, with depth varying by source and period. Data are free: the open data page says EIA data are provided free of charge, and API use needs a registered key and acceptance of the API terms of service; the browser page itself is rendered by script, so the API metadata were read instead. Formats are JSON from the API and downloads from the browser. Caveats: values for many countries are EIA estimates or come from national reporting of uneven quality, and recent months are revised. Simulation uses are supply and demand baselines for fuel supply chain and capacity planning studies, and import dependence and disruption analysis for energy security and resilience. Related records: data-eia-petroleum-supply-and-prices covers US petroleum statistics, and data-eia-natural-gas-data covers US gas.
